value.rationale: For the classical Pappus incidence graph this is the entire Tait-coloring reconfiguration state space, not only its class count. The theorem supplies a natural sign criterion that is both necessary and sufficient, with sharp two-switch diameter and an exact graph decomposition into two three-tetrahedron windmills. It is a meaningful finite-geometry and reconfiguration benchmark. The generic sign obstruction alone is not presented as a standalone contribution.
